description: The server sends the HTML in chunks over one response: the shell first, then each `<Suspense>` boundary as its data resolves.
Everything outside every `<Suspense>` boundary, plus the fallbacks. The stream starts when it is ready; an error in it fails the whole response.
Reads a promise during render. While it is pending the component suspends and the nearest `<Suspense>` fallback is shown.
Web Streams renderer (edge runtimes, Deno, Bun, browsers). Resolves with the stream when the shell is ready; `stream.allReady` resolves when every boundary is done.
Node streams renderer with `onShellReady`, `onShellError`, `onAllReady` and `onError` callbacks; call `pipe(response)` when the shell is ready.
Late boundaries arrive as hidden HTML plus a tiny inline script that replaces the fallback, in the order their data resolves.
Each boundary hydrates on its own as soon as it can; a boundary the user interacts with is hydrated first.
